name: What are common signs that my garage door trim needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my garage door trim needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your garage door trim needs repair include visible cracks, peeling paint, soft or spongy areas indicating wood rot, and gaps between the trim and the garage door frame or wall. You might also notice an increase in drafts inside your garage or evidence of pests entering. Discoloration or mold growth on the trim can also indicate moisture issues. Regularly inspecting your trim, especially after heavy rain or extreme temperatures, helps catch these issues early. If you observe any of these signs, prompt assessment by Maine Results, Inc. can prevent further damage to your Kuna or Star home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for cracks, peeling paint, soft spots, gaps, drafts, or pest entry as signs your garage door trim needs repair, especially after severe weather.
